title: Q-RES-knowledge-graph-2026-K1: The graph keeps itself current (measured 0.2, target >= 1)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: knowledge-graph-2026 finding K1 is not-met (measured 0.2)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe knowledge-graph-2026:K1
**Prediction:** kg_systems_share >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** open

Concern: The graph keeps itself current. The study: Every system Ultrastable runs keeps a knowledge graph of its own data, built and refreshed by its own tick, with no setup.

Mechanisms that should answer it: KGRAPH-1 (foundation/datagraph.py); KGRAPH-1 (seed/worker/src/graphai.js).

Metric: share of systems in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json whose knowledge graph is built, not pending, target >= 1. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
